attempts.summary: Created an LVM logical volume (datavg/datalv) backed by two loop devices on node1, formatted xfs, mounted at /srv/data, wrote test data with checksums, then grew it live from ~1.17GB to ~2.34GB (2,508,193,792 bytes) via vgextend/lvextend/xfs_growfs while mounted, with data verified intact. Configured a systemd unit (lvm-loop-disks.service) plus fstab entry so the loop-backed PVs and mount persist across reboot. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured healthy baseline (boot_id 1b0321bf...), restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed changed boot identity (b4e91734...), and verified post-restart the VG/LV/PVs were active, /srv/data was mounted at the grown 2.34GB size, and all data checksums still passed.
